metadata.title: fix: preserve server team_id during admin UI edits
metadata.author: kimsehwan96

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes: #3779

---

## 📝 Summary
When editing a virtual server via the admin UI, the server's `team_id` was silently overwritten on every save — even when the user did not intend to change the team.
                                                                                                                                                            
  **Root cause:** In `admin_edit_server()`, when no `team_id` is present in the form (e.g., editing from the "All Teams" view), `verify_team_for_user()` falls back to the current user's **personal team**, which is then unconditionally written to the server record.
                                                                                                                                                            
  **Fix:** Before calling `verify_team_for_user()`, the edit endpoint now looks up the existing server's `team_id` from the database and uses it as the default when the form does not include one. This preserves the original team assignment while still allowing explicit team changes via the API.

---

Recommended future work

- Explicit "transfer team" UI/API for intentional team reassignment
- Tool, Gateway, Prompt edit endpoints call `verify_team_for_user()` but their service layers don't persist the result (accidentally safe)

commits.message:
fix: preserve server team_id during admin UI edits

When editing a virtual server via the admin UI without an explicit
team_id in the form, verify_team_for_user() fell back to the current
user's personal team, silently reassigning the server on every edit.

Now the edit endpoint looks up the existing server's team_id and
preserves it when no team_id is provided in the form.

Closes: #3779

Signed-off-by: kimsehwan96 <sktpghks138@gmail.com>
commits.author: kimsehwan96

commits.message:
fix: preserve entity team_id during admin UI edits for all entity types

Extend the server team_id preservation fix to gateway, resource, prompt,
and A2A agent edit endpoints. All five endpoints now look up the existing
entity's team_id when no explicit team_id is provided in the form, instead
of silently falling back to the user's personal team.

Also fixes:
- resource edit was missing team_id and owner_email entirely
- prompt edit had a debug log typo ("befor")

Adds comprehensive tests for all five entity types covering the team_id
preservation path and the explicit team_id override path.

Closes: #3779
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: add service-layer team_id persistence and validation for all entity types

The admin-side team_id preservation (previous commit) was only effective for
server and A2A agent edits because only those service-layer update methods
actually persisted team_id to the ORM row. Gateway, resource, and prompt
services accepted team_id in their update DTOs but silently ignored it.

This commit:
- Adds team_id persistence to gateway_service.update_gateway()
- Adds team_id persistence to resource_service.update_resource()
- Adds team_id persistence to prompt_service.update_prompt()
- Adds team reassignment validation to a2a_service.update_agent()
  (previously persisted via generic setattr without ownership checks)
- Each service now validates team existence and caller ownership before
  allowing team reassignment, matching server_service's pattern

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix: validate visibility->"team" transitions in all entity services

The server service validates the effective team_id when visibility
changes to "team" (even when team_id is not explicitly provided in
the update), ensuring you cannot set visibility to "team" with an
invalid or missing team. The gateway, resource, prompt, and A2A
services were missing this validation.

Now all four services validate the target team_id (either from the
update DTO or from the existing entity) when visibility transitions
to "team", matching server_service's stricter pattern.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
test: add deny-path service tests for team_id validation

Add targeted deny-path tests for all four entity services verifying:
- Reassigning to a non-existent team is rejected
- Setting visibility to "team" without any team_id is rejected

These tests validate the service-layer validation logic, not just
admin-route DTO construction.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
test: achieve 100% differential coverage for team_id validation

Add tests for uncovered branches in team validation functions:
- Non-owner membership rejection (all 4 services)
- No-user-email early return path with team_id persistence
  (gateway, resource, prompt, A2A)

Differential coverage: 114 lines, 0 missing, 100%.
